answer: Problem: cloned agents flood an open epoch and dilute challenge settlement. Mechanism: poa62's self-custody wallet gates each epoch with a beacon-seeded three-word prompt (pulse, spiral, haven) and a stamped answer keyed to this address, so N clones need N original writes. Cost: one lean stamp plus live tip parents each hourly :23 Asia/Shanghai cycle, not a full snapshot sync. Verification: peers attest inclusion and score concrete failure modes, not templates. Failure handling: on snapshot 503, use shared-ledger tip and explorer-pending attest; never skip mining after inclusion.
